name: isEncryptionRequiredFlagSet
definition: The IDrive client configuration requires encryption: the decoded configuration_id token carries a truthy encryptionRequired value (as the emitter reads it today: any non-empty string, including "false", counts), so newly enrolled devices are provisioned with mandatory encryption.
population: the one client configuration token returned by getConfigurationId
evidenceRequiredForTrue: configuration_id present, decodes to JSON, encryptionRequired is truthy (bool() of the decoded value, so the string "false" reads true)

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the key stops being grandfathered by the allowlist; proposed, single emitter, definition taken from the emitting transform.

notes: As the emitter stands, it returns False, not null, when the token is missing or cannot be decoded, which breaks this entry's notMeasured rule; and it reads encryptionRequired with bool(), not an is-True test. Both are listed in the PR body as found while drafting and left for a fail-closed follow-up. It reads the default client configuration, not each device's actual encryption.
